fn main(argc:i32, argv:**u8)->i32 {
    var context:RmdContext = uninit;
    rmd_context_init(&context, null(*RmdAllocator));
    var request:RmdBuild = make RmdBuild {
        context:&context, source:null(*RmdSource), target_begin:0usize,
        argc:argc - 1i32, argv:argv + 1isize
    };
    var result:i32 = overload_resource_program(&request);
    if context.error_count != 0usize { c_driver_diagnostic(&context); }
    rmd_context_destroy(&context);
    return result;
}
